Name: (AT) Cute White and Pastel Wizard Furniture
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
Whoever could have imagined that the dear old wizard Rasmodius could have such a [i]cute[/i] sense of style to have all his furniture available in white and pastel tones? Well, I imagined it, and thus it's been born, a content pack for the fantastic [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url], by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url], that includes almost every piece of furniture available from the wizard's catalogue redone in white, pastel pink, purple, and blue! In fact, the only piece of furniture untouched by this content pack is the starry rug- [i]everything[/i] else is recolored by hand by me! If you were looking for some more cute furniture to match your cute aesthetic in Stardew Valley, look no further, and enjoy!

[b]Installation: [/b]
[b]1. [/b]Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
[b]2. [/b]Unzip the '[AT] Cute White & Pastel Wizard Furniture' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
[b]3. [/b]Buy the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]Paint Bucket[/url] tool from Robin, to use on your items and retexture them.
[b]4. [/b]Congrats, you're done and ready to retexture! Enjoy your new furniture!
